summary: Trump says he urged Putin to 'pull back' military aggression in Europe amid escalating Russian and Ukrainian attacks.

body_en: Share Zelenskyy warns of major Russian attack as Trump urges Putin to ‘pull back’ on social media
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine has information that Russia is preparing a new mass strike on the country in the coming days.

“Unfortunately, we have information about a new mass strike being prepared by the Russians,” he said in his nightly video address on Thursday. “In the coming days, please pay attention to the alarms of missile threats.”

It was the second such warning from Zelenskyy this week. He also had a message for Moscow: “We will rebuild what is ours and retaliate against every Russian strike.”
US President Donald Trump said he had pressed Russian President Vladimir Putin to ease Russia’s military actions in Europe.
In a post on Truth Social, Trump said he spent “a lot of time” in talks with Putin in China on the issue of Putin pulling back “all Military aggression against territories throughout Europe”.

“Thousands of people are being killed each and every month, A COMPLETE BLOODBATH,” Trump wrote. He said he hoped that would allow a deal between Russia and Ukraine to be “made quickly”, which he called “a strong possibility”.
Trump said he updated NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte on the talks during a meeting at his Mar-a-Lago club in Florida on Wednesday night.
Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles overnight, wounding seven people and hitting a shopping centre and two other buildings, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.
Moscow said it hit drone-related sites in the city. Russian forces have attacked Kyiv and other cities almost continuously since September.
Ukraine said its drones hit an oil refinery in Russia’s southern Krasnodar region, oil reservoirs at a Transneft facility in Bashkortostan and the Marinovka military airfield in the Volgograd region.

Ukraine has also widened its attacks at sea. On Monday, Zelenskyy said Ukraine used seven naval drones to hit the Russian corvette Merkury and the cargo ship Angara off Libya . Libyan officials told the Associated Press news agency that the Merkury was heavily damaged but not sunk.

At about the same time, a suspected Ukrainian drone struck the Russia-bound cargo ship Sparta II in the Baltic Sea, near Finland. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov called the attacks a “ very dangerous trend “.
At least four Russian vessels have been targeted this month.

European Union leaders are struggling at a summit in Brussels to agree on a new 45 billion euro ($49bn) loan to help Ukraine meet its economic and military needs next year. It would come on top of a 90 billion euro ($99bn) loan , agreed nearly a year ago, that covers most of Ukraine’s government needs for 2026 and 2027.
Early on Friday in Brussels, European Council President Antonio Costa said that 24 member states supported the new loan , as talks on the bloc’s next seven-year budget stretched on.

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他已向俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京施压，要求其缓解俄罗斯在欧洲的军事行动。
特朗普在《Truth Social》上发表的一篇文章中表示，他花了“很多时间”在中国与普京会谈，讨论普京撤回“对整个欧洲领土的所有军事侵略”的问题。
特朗普写道：“每个月都有数千人被杀，这是一场彻底的大屠杀。”他表示，他希望俄罗斯和乌克兰能够“迅速”达成协议，他称之为“可能性很大”。
特朗普表示，他周三晚上在佛罗里达州海湖庄园举行的一次会议上向北约秘书长马克·吕特通报了会谈的最新情况。
市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，俄罗斯连夜用弹道导弹袭击了基辅，造成七人受伤，并击中了一座购物中心和另外两座建筑物。
莫斯科表示，它袭击了该市与无人机相关的地点。自9月份以来，俄罗斯军队几乎连续不断地袭击基辅和其他城市。
乌克兰表示，其无人机袭击了俄罗斯南部克拉斯诺达尔地区的一家炼油厂、巴什科尔托斯坦的石油运输公司设施的油库以及伏尔加格勒地区的马里诺夫卡军用机场。
乌克兰还扩大了海上袭击范围。泽连斯基周一表示，乌克兰使用七架海军无人机袭击了利比亚附近的俄罗斯护卫舰“水星号”和货船“安加拉号”。利比亚官员告诉美联社，水星号受损严重，但并未沉没。
大约在同一时间，一架疑似乌克兰无人机在芬兰附近的波罗的海袭击了开往俄罗斯的货船斯巴达二号。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫称这些袭击是“非常危险的趋势”。

title_en: New Zealand election: final results show ruling coalition needs minor party to govern
title_zh: 新西兰大选：最终结果显示执政联盟需要小党执政
summary: Incumbent prime minister Christopher Luxon loses majority and needs support of Opportunity party to remain in power, or country faces another election The final results of New Zealand’s general election show the incumbent rightwing coalition will need the supp
summary_zh: 现任总理克里斯托弗·卢克森失去多数席位，需要机会党的支持才能继续执政，否则国家将面临另一次选举
body_en: Incumbent prime minister Christopher Luxon loses majority and needs support of Opportunity party to remain in power, or country faces another election

The final results of New Zealand’s general election show the incumbent rightwing coalition will need the support of a centrist newcomer party to form a government, and to avoid sending the country back to the polls.

Preliminary results on 7 November handed the National party and its two coalition partners, the populist New Zealand First and libertarian Act parties, a slim two-seat majority, making the election too close to call until final votes were tallied.

On Friday, the electoral commission released the results from nearly 485,000 “special votes” – those cast from overseas or outside a voter’s electorate. National dropped two seats to 40, Labour stayed on 36 seats, the Greens picked up one seat to 17, Act had 13, New Zealand First 12, Opportunity seven and Te Pati Māori five.
The National-led bloc currently has 65 seats. In the 130-seat parliament, 66 seats are needed for a majority.

The revised results mean the National-led coalition has the only realistic path to power – if it can negotiate a deal with Opportunity. If it cannot, New Zealand will probably need to hold another election.
New Zealand’s Opportunity party takes aim at populist politics as it prepares to enter parliament

Three electorate seats changed hands after the special votes. Labour won Wairarapa off National with just 81 votes, and took Hamilton East from National with 173 votes. The Greens won Wellington Bays from Labour with 1,610 votes.

If National applies for a recount and wins back just one of those seats, it could return to power with a slim majority and without needing Opportunity. Applications for a recount must be made by 3 December, and results could take another five days.

Special votes in previous elections have favoured the left, and typically have cost the right one or two seats. Until Friday, a question mark hung over whether National would be able to govern comfortably alongside its coalition partners, or whether it would be forced to cut a deal with the Opportunity party – a newcomer centrist party that incumbent prime minister Christopher Luxon had previously ruled out working with.
After the election, Luxon softened his stance on his initial rule-out, saying he intended to find common ground with the Opportunity party.
On Friday afternoon, Luxon said National will now begin formal negotiations with New Zealand First, Act and Opportunity, but he cautioned discussions would be “challenging” and could take some time.
“Getting it right matters far more than getting it done quickly,” Luxon said. “Kiwis won’t thank us for rushing to an agreement that falls apart, or for sending them back to the polls.”

Lara Greaves, a political scientist at Victoria University of Wellington, said the prospect of New Zealand heading back to the polls was unprecedented, because negotiations between the four parties will be so complex.
“It’s not a 0% chance, it’s the highest chance we’ve ever had of it being another election,” she said.
Opportunity, led by Auckland businesswoman Qiulae Wong , has long said it will negotiate first with the party that secures the highest number of seats.

After the final results were announced, Wong confirmed she would speak with Luxon and that her party’s bottom-lines – which include climate and environment policies and capping political donations – were non-negotiable.
The party would focus on bringing New Zealanders a stable government, Wong told media, and she did not rule out heading back to the polls.

“Clearly stability is important. But setting that more hopeful and aspirational vision, where we can come together as much as possible as New Zealanders and move forward, I think is the priority,” she said.
body_zh: 现任总理克里斯托弗·卢克森失去多数席位，需要机会党的支持才能继续执政，否则国家将面临另一次选举
新西兰大选的最终结果显示，现任右翼联盟将需要中间派新人政党的支持才能组建政府，并避免让该国重新投票。
11 月 7 日的初步结果显示，国家党及其两个联盟伙伴——民粹主义的“新西兰优先党”和自由意志主义法案党获得了微弱的两个席位多数，这使得选举结果在最终计票之前难以确定。
周五，选举委员会公布了近 485,000 张“特别选票”（来自海外或选民选区之外的选票）的结果。国家党减少 2 个席位，至 40 个，工党保留 36 个席位，绿党增加 1 个席位，至 17 个，行动党 13 个，新西兰优先党 12 个，机会党 7 个，毛利党 5 个。
国家党领导的政党目前拥有 65 个席位。在130个席位的议会中，需要66个席位才能获得多数席位。
修改后的结果意味着国家党领导的联盟拥有唯一现实的掌权之路——如果它能够与机遇号谈判达成协议。如果不能，新西兰可能需要再次举行选举。
新西兰机会党准备进入议会，瞄准民粹主义政治
特别投票后，三个选举席位易手。工党仅以 81 票从国家党手中赢得了怀拉拉帕 (Wairarapa)，并以 173 票从国家党手中赢得了汉密尔顿东 (Hamilton East)。绿党以 1,610 票从工党手中赢得了惠灵顿湾区。
如果国家党申请重新计票并仅赢回其中一个席位，它就可以以微弱多数重新掌权，而无需机会党。重新计票申请必须在 12 月 3 日之前提出，结果可能还需要五天时间才能得到结果。
以往选举中的特别投票对左翼有利，通常会导致右翼失去一两个席位。直到周五，一个问号一直悬而未决，问题是国家党是否能够与联盟伙伴一起舒适地执政，或者是否会被迫与机会党达成协议。机会党是一个新来的中间派政党，现任总理克里斯托弗·卢克森此前曾排除与机会党合作的可能性。
选举结束后，卢克森软化了他最初排除的立场，称他打算与机会党找到共同点。
周五下午，卢克森表示，国家党现在将开始与“新西兰优先”、“行动”和“机会”组织进行正式谈判，但他警告说，讨论将是“具有挑战性的”，并且可能需要一些时间。
“把事情做好比快速完成更重要，”卢克森说。 “新西兰人不会感谢我们仓促达成一项最终破裂的协议，也不会感谢我们让他们重新投票。”
惠灵顿维多利亚大学政治学家劳拉·格里夫斯表示，新西兰重返民意调查的前景是前所未有的，因为四党之间的谈判将非常复杂。
她说：“这不是 0% 的可能性，这是我们经历过的最高可能性的另一次选举。”
由奥克兰女商人 Qiulae Wong 领导的机会党长期以来一直表示，将首先与获得最多席位的政党进行谈判。
最终结果公布后，黄确认她将与卢克森交谈，并表示她所在政党的底线——包括气候和环境政策以及政治捐款上限——是不容谈判的。
黄告诉媒体，该党将专注于为新西兰人带来一个稳定的政府，她不排除重返民意调查的可能性。
“显然稳定很重要。但我认为首要任务是设定一个更有希望、更有抱负的愿景，让新西兰人尽可能地团结起来并继续前进，”她说。

title_en: Threat from China looms large over Taiwan’s local elections
title_zh: 台湾地方选举面临来自中国的巨大威胁
summary: Taiwanese officials raise alarm over interference by China in elections that will shape fortunes of ruling party Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive p
summary_zh: 台湾官员对中国干预选举发出警告，这将影响执政党的命运
body_en: Taiwanese officials raise alarm over interference by China in elections that will shape fortunes of ruling party

Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party (DPP) as it navigates an increasingly precarious set of relationships on the global stage.

Saturday’s vote will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts. Unlike the presidential elections, in which foreign policy is often a key issue, the local elections, held every four years , are largely focused on bread-and-butter issues such as housing affordability and wealth distribution.

Nevertheless, China looms large over the vote, which takes place against the background of intense military pressure from Beijing . China claims Taiwan as part of its territory despite never having ruled the self-governing island. Taiwanese officials have raised the alarm over thousands of incidents of suspected misinformation or election interference, and certain candidates have been subjected to harassment from the Chinese authorities. There have also been reports of hundreds of China-linked AI-generated videos spreading disinformation about Taiwanese politicians disliked by Beijing.

Beijing calls the allegations of election interference “completely fabricated”. Zhu Fenglian, a spokesperson for China’s Taiwan affairs office, said the allegations “stir up anti-China sentiment to win votes”.

Wei-Ting Yen, a political scientist at Academia Sinica, Taiwan’s national research academy, said: “Even though local elections are not about China, the outcome of local elections will have huge implications for cross-strait relations.”

Most races are a tight competition between a candidate from the ruling DPP and the main opposition party, the Kuomintang (KMT). The KMT promotes closer ties with Beijing, and its chair, Cheng Li-wun, travelled to China this year to meet Xi Jinping, China’s leader. Xi has vowed to unify China with Taiwan, and has not ruled out using military action to achieve that aim.
Yen said if the KMT loses some of its traditional strongholds, Beijing “may need to reconsider what is the most effective strategy for influencing Taiwanese people”.

One of the most contentious votes is the race for Taipei mayor, an office that has been held by the KMT for three decades. The DPP has selected as its challenger Puma Shen, a national legislator whom Beijing declared a “diehard separatist” in 2024. It is the first time a candidate under sanctions by Beijing has run to be mayor of Taiwan’s capital city. In the neighbouring New Tapei City race, the DPP’s Su Chiao-hui is also proving to be a ferocious challenger to the incumbent KMT.
Shen said in a recent interview that even if he didn’t win, the capital’s mayoral race was “a slap to China” because it proved that “democracy works here in Taiwan”.

Huang Bo-kai, a 23-year-old law student, said his top concern was cross-strait relations and how US-China relations were evolving. “The world’s three major powers are increasingly willing to flex their muscles: the US attacking Iran, Russia attacking Ukraine. I think Taiwan could very well be the next target [of China],” he told the Guardian.

Taiwan’s president, the DPP’s Lai Ching-te, is detested by Beijing and has taken a bolshier stance on cross-strait relations than his predecessor, Tsai Ing-wen, who was admired for her ability to drum up support in Washington while walking a delicate tightrope to avoid angering China.

Lai has pushed for greater spending on weapons to deter military aggression from China. The government has proposed a record 18% increase in defence spending for next year, including for drones and missiles, taking it above 1tn Taiwan dollars (£23bn) for the first time.

But many Taiwanese voters would rather that money was spent on more immediate economic issues. Lev Nachman, a political scientist at National Taiwan University, said the national leaders of the DPP and KMT had been notably absent from the mayoral races, reflecting the extent to which campaigns were focused on local issues.

Going into the campaigns for the 2028 presidential elections, Lai would “try to take advantage of the momentum that [Shen] and Su have built for the DPP,” Nachman said, noting that support for those candidates would not necessarily translate into support for Lai.
Tony Yeh, a Taipei man in his 70s, said: “To put it simply, the authorities should do more to boost the economy and buy fewer weapons.”

Taiwan’s economy has boomed this year, largely thanks to the pivotal role that its semiconductor industry plays in the global artificial intelligence rally. The economy grew by more than 14% in the first nine months of the year, the fastest rate in 50 years. But nearly 70% of workers earned less than the average monthly wage of 49,152 Taiwan dollars (£1,137) in the same period.
Yeh said: “Most traditional industries are having a really tough time.”

William Yang, a senior analyst at the International Crisis Group, said: “The issues that really are going to determine their votes are livelihood issues including the stagnant wage, the astronomically high housing price, the affordability issue, and how the government can better make sure Taiwan’s incredible economic boom fuelled by the global AI growth is going to be distributed more evenly.”
body_zh: 台湾官员对中国干预选举发出警告，这将影响执政党的命运
台湾选民周六将在备受关注的地方选举中进行投票，这将决定执政的民进党（DPP）的命运，因为该党在全球舞台上应对日益不稳定的关系。
周六的投票将选出 22 个区的市长、议会成员和其他地方领导人。与外交政策往往成为关键问题的总统选举不同，每四年举行一次的地方选举主要关注住房负担能力和财富分配等基本问题。
尽管如此，这次投票是在北京施加巨大军事压力的背景下进行的，中国在这次投票中显得尤为重要。中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，尽管从未统治过这个自治岛屿。台湾官员对数千起涉嫌虚假信息或选举干扰的事件发出警报，某些候选人还受到中国当局的骚扰。还有报道称，数百个与中国有关的人工智能生成的视频传播了有关北京不喜欢的台湾政客的虚假信息。
北京称有关选举干预的指控“完全是捏造的”。中国台湾事务办公室发言人朱凤莲表示，这些指控“煽动反华情绪以赢得选票”。
台湾国家研究院中央研究院政治学家颜伟霆表示：“尽管地方选举与中国无关，但地方选举的结果将对两岸关系产生巨大影响。”
大多数竞选都是执政的民进党候选人与主要反对党国民党候选人之间的激烈竞争。国民党推动与北京建立更紧密的关系，其主席郑立文今年前往中国会见中国领导人习近平。习近平誓言要统一中国和台湾，并且不排除使用军事行动来实现这一目标。
颜说，如果国民党失去一些传统据点，北京“可能需要重新考虑影响台湾人民的最有效策略”。
最具争议性的投票之一是台北市长的竞选，该职位已由国民党担任了三十年。民进党选择了2024年被北京宣布为“顽固分裂分子”的全国立委沉普马作为其挑战者。这是首次受到北京制裁的候选人竞选台湾首都市长。在邻近的新台北市竞选中，民进党的苏教辉也被证明是现任国民党的猛烈挑战者。
沉在最近的一次采访中表示，即使他没有获胜，首都市长竞选也是“对中国的一记耳光”，因为它证明“民主在台湾行得通”。
23 岁的法学院学生黄博凯表示，他最关心的是两岸关系以及中美关系如何演变。 “世界三大强国越来越愿意展示自己的实力：美国攻击伊朗，俄罗斯攻击乌克兰。我认为台湾很可能成为（中国）的下一个目标，”他告诉《卫报》。
台湾总统、民进党的赖清德受到北京方面的憎恶，并且在两岸关系问题上比其前任蔡英文采取了更为强硬的立场。蔡英文因其在华盛顿争取支持的能力而受到钦佩，同时又在避免激怒中国方面走着微妙的钢丝。
赖先生推动增加武器支出，以阻止中国的军事侵略。政府提议将明年的国防开支增加 18%，创历史新高，其中包括无人机和导弹，首次超过 1 万亿新台币（230 亿英镑）。
但许多台湾选民宁愿把钱花在更紧迫的经济问题上。国立台湾大学政治学家列夫·纳赫曼表示，民进党和国民党的国家领导人明显缺席了市长竞选，这反映出竞选活动对地方问题的关注程度。
纳赫曼表示，在进入 2028 年总统选举的竞选活动中，赖智将“尝试利用[沉]和苏为民进党建立的势头”，并指出对这些候选人的支持不一定会转化为对赖智的支持。
70 多岁的台北男子托尼·叶 (Tony Yeh) 表示：“简单来说，当局应该采取更多措施来提振经济，并减少购买武器。”
台湾经济今年蓬勃发展，很大程度上得益于其半导体产业在全球人工智能涨势中发挥的关键作用。今年前9个月经济增长超过14%，为50年来最快增速。但近 70% 的工人同期收入低于平均月工资 49,152 新台币（1,137 英镑）。
叶说：“大多数传统行业都在经历非常艰难的时期。”
国际危机组织高级分析师杨威廉表示：“真正决定他们选票的问题是民生问题，包括停滞的工资、天文数字般的房价、负担能力问题，以及政府如何更好地确保全球人工智能增长推动的台湾令人难以置信的经济繁荣将得到更均匀的分配。”

title_en: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
title_zh: 联邦快递飞机冲出迈阿密跑道，机场航班短暂暂停
summary: Almost one million customers in the US had no power on Thursday evening as storms descended on both US coasts, bringing wind gusts, heavy rain and flooding.
summary_zh: 这次短暂的地面停留是在美国感恩节假期的前一天，这是一年中最繁忙的旅行日之一。
body_en: By Ana Faguy , James FitzGerald and Sareen Habeshian
A massive Thanksgiving storm hammering the Midwest and north-east with heavy rain and winds, along with high tides out west, is causing widespread disruptions across the US.

More than 80 million Americans expected to be travelling this week. More than 400 flights in the US were cancelled on Thursday and another 2,200 flights into, out of, or within the US were delayed, tracking site FlightAware said.
The FAA has previously warned that delays would be possible "throughout the week" as a result of the rain and wind that are forecast.
Meanwhile, almost one million households were without power on Thursday night, with Pennsylvania, Maryland and Virginia the hardest hit states.
On Thursday, a powerful storm hit the eastern US, bringing damaging winds of up to 70mph, torrential rain, and major coastal flooding.
New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill declared a state of emergency as several communities along the Jersey Shore saw widespread flooding.
New York Governor Kathy Hochul also declared a state of emergency for New York City, Long Island and Westchester County.
In New York City, organisers of the annual Macy's Thanksgiving parade have postponed the event to Saturday.
Bridges closed in Maryland due to severe winds and waves battered beaches in Delaware as water seeped onto the boardwalk.
In Maryland, almost two million customers have been asked by the water utility to use water for essential use only due to "intermittent power disruptions".
On the wettest Thanksgiving on record in Washington DC, tidal waters surged and soaked runways at Reagan Washington National Airport, according to the National Water Prediction Service.
More than 980,000 households were reporting power outages by Thursday evening, with Pennsylvania, Virginia, Maryland and New Jersey hit particularly hard.

Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said that utility providers were working tirelessly to restore power. Meanwhile, energy companies in Virginia and New Jersey warned it may take some time, even days, for power to return, as crews had to wait until it was safe to access damaged areas.
On Thursday afternoon, President Donald Trump said he would consider releasing emergency funds for the east coast as it faces down the holiday storm.
Across the US, severe weather is also descending on the West Coast. The NWS has warned of a series of Pacific storms that are expected to bring rain, mountain snow and strong winds.
Many are bracing for potential flooding as king tides peak along the coast.
Water levels along California's vast coastline could reach over 8ft (2.4 metres) in some areas on Thursday, according to the NWS, breaking records set just last month.
Both San Diego and Los Angeles reported a high tide of over 8ft earlier in the week, and beach-goers were advised to avoid coastal areas.
Train services along the Amtrak Pacific Surfliner, which runs along the California coastline, cancelled several trains due to "washout conditions from high tides", the company shared on social media.
body_zh: 作者：Ana Faguy、James FitzGerald 和 Sareen Habeshian
一场大规模的感恩节风暴袭击了中西部和东北部，带来大雨和大风，以及西部的涨潮，正在美国各地造成大范围的破坏。
预计本周将有超过 8000 万美国人出行。追踪网站 FlightAware 称，周四美国境内 400 多架航班被取消，另有 2,200 架进出美国或境内的航班延误。
美国联邦航空局此前曾警告称，由于预计有雨和风，“整周”都可能出现延误。
与此同时，周四晚上，近一百万户家庭断电，其中宾夕法尼亚州、马里兰州和弗吉尼亚州是受灾最严重的州。
周四，一场强大的风暴袭击了美国东部，带来了时速高达 70 英里/小时的破坏性大风、暴雨和严重的沿海洪水。
新泽西州州长米基·谢里尔宣布进入紧急状态，因为泽西海岸的几个社区出现了大范围的洪水。
纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔还宣布纽约市、长岛和威彻斯特县进入紧急状态。
在纽约市，一年一度的梅西百货感恩节游行的组织者已将活动推迟到周六。
由于强风和海浪袭击特拉华州的海滩，水渗入木板路，马里兰州的桥梁关闭。
在马里兰州，由于“间歇性断电”，自来水公司要求近 200 万客户仅将水用于必要用途。
据国家水预测服务中心称，在华盛顿特区有记录以来最潮湿的感恩节，潮水汹涌，淹没了里根华盛顿国家机场的跑道。
截至周四晚上，超过 98 万户家庭报告停电，其中宾夕法尼亚州、弗吉尼亚州、马里兰州和新泽西州受到的影响尤其严重。
宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗表示，公用事业提供商正在不懈地努力恢复电力。与此同时，弗吉尼亚州和新泽西州的能源公司警告称，可能需要一段时间，甚至几天的时间才能恢复供电，因为工作人员必须等到安全后才能进入受损地区。
周四下午，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，他将考虑为东海岸发放紧急资金，以应对假日风暴。
在美国各地，西海岸也遭遇了恶劣天气。国家气象局警告称，一系列太平洋风暴预计将带来降雨、山雪和强风。
随着海岸潮汐达到顶峰，许多人都在为可能发生的洪水做好准备。
据国家气象局称，周四，加州广阔海岸线部分地区的水位可能达到 8 英尺（2.4 米）以上，打破了上个月创下的记录。
圣地亚哥和洛杉矶本周早些时候都报告了超过 8 英尺的高潮，建议海滩游客避开沿海地区。
该公司在社交媒体上表示，由于“涨潮造成的冲刷情况”，沿加州海岸线运行的Amtrak Pacific Surfliner沿线的列车服务取消了几趟列车。

title_en: Russia-Ukraine war extends to the Baltic and the Mediterranean
title_zh: 俄乌战争延伸至波罗的海和地中海
summary: By attacking Russian vessels around the world, Kyiv is trying to up the pressure on Moscow and also sending out signals to its Western allies. What is the impact on global maritime trade?
summary_zh: 通过攻击世界各地的俄罗斯船只，基辅试图加大对莫斯科的压力，并向其西方盟友发出信号。什么是
body_en: First there was an attack on a Russian cargo vessel, the Sparta II, off the Finnish coast, then on the Russian corvette Merkury and a dry cargo vessel that was allegedly carrying weapons off the coast of Libya. These spectacular Ukrainian operations in regions far from the Ukrainian capital Kyiv have caused a stir. They came shortly after several suspected Russian missiles crashed in Poland, not far from where an international military exercise was underway.
Intelligence agencies have long warned that Russia was preparing some form of provocation along NATO's eastern flank.
What are the risks of Russia's war in Ukraine escalating further and drawing in other regions?

It is no secret that Russia has long since expanded its operations beyond Ukraine: With military provocation, hybrid operations and acts of sabotage, Moscow has attempted to put pressure on the countries that openly support Ukraine.
And Ukraine has also targeted Russia's military and economy beyond its borders.

Since the summer, attacks by both Russia and Ukraine have increased in the Black Sea. Not only have Russian and Ukrainian cargo ships been targeted, but also vessels from other countries, particularly Turkey.

Furthermore, in the past few years, Ukraine has managed to deal significant blows to Russia, deep within Russian territory, thanks to aerial and maritime drones. It has targeted military airfields and other strategic targets such as oil refineries, including one in Omsk, Siberia, as well as military vessels in the eastern Black Sea.

Russia has access only to a very narrow strip of the Baltic Sea coast, which is flanked by Finland and Estonia. Even ahead of the attack on the Sparta II, Ukraine had struck in the area multiple times, targeting oil terminals in the region around St. Petersburg, in Ust-Luga and Primorsk.
Russia uses the Baltic Sea to transport supplies to its Kaliningrad exclave and to export oil and other goods to the rest of the world, with the help of its "shadow fleet."

Ukrainian special forces are also said to have carried out operations against Russian military facilities in Syria , well before the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024. They are also reported to have lent support to local Tuareg fighters in Mali who were able to inflict heavy losses on the Malian army and allied Russian mercenaries.
Kyiv is thus attempting to harm Russia's military and economy worldwide, even if in military terms this does not help Ukraine directly.

The Russian corvette that was sunk was part of Russia's Black Sea Fleet but because of Turkey's blockade of the Bosporus and the Dardanelles, it would not have been allowed to return to the Black Sea. Instead, it was escorting Russian cargo ships in the Mediterranean. Primarily, the attacks send a political message: Russian ships can no longer feel safe — anywhere in the world.

"We are not speaking about random shadow vessels which simply transport oil above the price cap and as a result bring revenues for the Russian treasury," security expert Elisabeth Braw from the Atlantic Council told DW. Sparta II was suspected of carrying military equipment, which Moscow denies.

" Ukraine is showing that it knows exactly, and secondly that it's able to hit them wherever and whatever waters they are in," Braw continued. "And this is something I don't think Ukraine has been able to do at the beginning of the war."

Officially, Kyiv's goal is to disrupt Russian logistics and supply routes, but military experts and politicians also see the attacks as a clear political signal to Western allies. They suspect that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is sending a clear message of strength with an eye toward possible future peace negotiations.

In an interview on the German news outlet Tagesschau, security expert Joachim Weber from the University of Bonn suggested that Zelenskyy was paying less attention to the US, out of a sense of disappointment. He said that Ukrainian attacks in distant maritime areas were a sign that there was less inhibition and that Ukraine was ready to expand the conflict geographically to increase pressure on Russia , despite the risks.

Weber warned that war could become omnipresent if there was an increase in attacks on civilian vessels or ships that were considered suspicious in international waters. He said that Russia was providing more military escorts for the ships of its shadow fleet. "The likelihood that an accidental exchange of fire between armed forces, coast guards or anyone could occur is rising."

Braw pointed out that violations of the Law of the Sea were not only rising with regard to the Russia-Ukraine war but also in relation to other conflicts and playing out in "the South China Sea , the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea."
body_zh: 首先，一艘俄罗斯货船“斯巴达二号”在芬兰海岸附近遭到袭击，然后又袭击了俄罗斯护卫舰“水星”号和一艘据称在利比亚海岸附近运载武器的干货船。乌克兰在远离乌克兰首都基辅的地区进行的这些壮观的行动引起了轰动。此前不久，几枚疑似俄罗斯导弹在波兰坠毁，距离正在进行国际军事演习的地方不远。
情报机构长期以来一直警告称，俄罗斯正准备沿北约东翼进行某种形式的挑衅。
俄罗斯乌克兰战争进一步升级并波及其他地区有何风险？
众所周知，俄罗斯早已将其行动扩展到乌克兰之外：通过军事挑衅、混合行动和破坏行为，莫斯科试图向公开支持乌克兰的国家施加压力。
乌克兰还瞄准了俄罗斯境外的军事和经济。
自夏季以来，俄罗斯和乌克兰在黑海的袭击事件有所增加。不仅俄罗斯和乌克兰的货船成为攻击目标，其他国家（尤其是土耳其）的船只也成为攻击目标。
此外，在过去几年中，乌克兰凭借空中和海上无人机，成功地在俄罗斯领土深处对俄罗斯造成了重大打击。它的目标是军用机场和炼油厂等其他战略目标，其中包括西伯利亚鄂木斯克的炼油厂，以及黑海东部的军舰。
俄罗斯只能进入波罗的海沿岸非常狭窄的地带，两侧是芬兰和爱沙尼亚。甚至在斯巴达二号遭到袭击之前，乌克兰就已多次袭击该地区，目标是圣彼得堡周边地区、乌斯季卢加和普里莫尔斯克的石油码头。
俄罗斯利用波罗的海向其飞地加里宁格勒运输物资，并在其“影子舰队”的帮助下向世界其他地区出口石油和其他货物。
据称，早在 2024 年 12 月阿萨德政权倒台之前，乌克兰特种部队就曾对俄罗斯在叙利亚的军事设施采取行动。据报道，他们还向马里当地图阿雷格战士提供支持，这些战士能够给马里军队和俄罗斯盟军雇佣兵造成重大损失。
因此，基辅试图在全球范围内损害俄罗斯的军事和经济，即使从军事角度来看，这并不能直接帮助乌克兰。
被击沉的俄罗斯护卫舰是俄罗斯黑海舰队的一部分，但由于土耳其封锁博斯普鲁斯海峡和达达尼尔海峡，该舰无法返回黑海。相反，它在地中海护送俄罗斯货船。这些袭击主要传递了一个政治信息：俄罗斯船只在世界任何地方都不再感到安全。

大西洋理事会安全专家伊丽莎白·布劳（Elisabeth Braw）对德国之声表示：“我们并不是在谈论随机的影子船只，它们只是运输超出价格上限的石油，从而为俄罗斯财政部带来收入。”斯巴达二号被怀疑携带军事装备，莫斯科否认这一点。
布劳继续说道：“乌克兰正在表明它清楚地知道，其次它能够打击他们，无论他们在哪里，无论他们在什么水域。” “我认为乌克兰在战争开始时无法做到这一点。”
基辅的官方目标是破坏俄罗斯的后勤和供应路线，但军事专家和政界人士也将这些袭击视为向西方盟友发出的明确政治信号。他们怀疑乌克兰总统泽连斯基正在发出明确的强势信息，着眼于未来可能的和平谈判。
波恩大学安全专家约阿希姆·韦伯在接受德国新闻媒体 Tagesschau 采访时表示，泽伦斯基出于失望感，对美国的关注较少。他表示，乌克兰对遥远海域的袭击表明，抑制措施有所减少，乌克兰准备将冲突扩大到地理范围，以加大对俄罗斯的压力，尽管存在风险。
韦伯警告说，如果对民用船只或国际水域中被认为可疑的船只的袭击增加，战争可能会变得无所不在。他说，俄罗斯正在为其影子舰队的船只提供更多的军事护航。 “武装部队、海岸警卫队或任何人之间发生意外交火的可能性正在上升。”
布劳指出，违反海洋法的行为不仅在俄罗斯和乌克兰战争中不断增加，而且在“南海、霍尔木兹海峡和红海”的其他冲突中也有所增加。

title_en: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
title_zh: 泽连斯基告诉 BBC，美国过于关注中东，对俄罗斯施加的压力不够
summary: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is "strange" Trump has described Vladimir Putin as a friend.
summary_zh: 乌克兰总统对美国表示失望，并表示特朗普将弗拉基米尔·普京描述为朋友“很奇怪”。
body_en: Zelensky tells BBC US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough - BBC News
By Sarah Rainsford, Southern and Eastern Europe correspondent

Volodymyr Zelensky has voiced deep frustration with the US, saying delays in delivering vital anti-ballistic missiles are costing Ukrainian lives and complaining that the US is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks.
In an interview with the BBC at his central Kyiv office, Ukraine's president also said it was "strange" that Donald Trump had posted a photo of himself embracing Vladimir Putin as "my friend".
"Of course it's up to the President of the United States, but... it's strange," Zelensky said, speaking in English.
"He's an aggressor, and a killer…He can't be a friend. Just cannot be," he said, adding it was like saying you were friends with Adolf Hitler during World War Two.
Since a bruising encounter with Trump in the Oval Office in 2025, Zelensky has been careful how he handles relations with the United States.
Trump's two envoys have been trying to negotiate a peace deal between Russia and Ukraine - to end the huge loss of life. But they often seem more in tune with Moscow's position, than that of Kyiv.
The latest round of peace talks, mediated in Abu Dhabi earlier this month, made no obvious progress: "The more we know, the more problems", is how Zelensky described it.
He said talks were expected to resume in December.

On Thursday, Donald Trump posted on his Truth Social platform that at his own summit with Putin in China last week he had urged Russia to "pull back all military aggression against territories throughout Europe" and said he believed a peace deal with Ukraine was "a strong possibility".
But from its public statements, Russia appears to have regressed to its initial, hardline negotiating positions – on everything.
And Zelensky revealed that it was not clear whether European negotiators would be at the table, as the US envoys had announced .
Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend
Ukraine urgently needs the talks to move forward and bring five exhausting years of Russia's full-scale invasion to an end.
Russian strikes across the country have been growing more frequent and more deadly: the number of civilians being killed is at an all-time high.
So Zelensky called for "real helpful allies, who can push Russia" to achieve results and urged the US to live up to its reputation as a strong country with "power and respect".
"When you try to be very neutral with the aggressor... it means you support victims and you support also aggressor. It's not right," he said.
The US argues that it is neutral: in the complex search for a peace deal between the two sides that can hold.
body_zh: 泽伦斯基告诉 BBC 美国过于关注中东，而对俄罗斯施加的压力不够 -_澳门赌博平台
作者：Sarah Rainsford，南欧和东欧记者
弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基对美国表达了深深的失望，他表示，重要反弹道导弹的延迟交付正在导致乌克兰人丧生，并抱怨美国在和平谈判中没有对俄罗斯施加足够的压力。
乌克兰总统在基辅市中心办公室接受英国广播公司采访时还表示，唐纳德·特朗普张贴了一张自己拥抱弗拉基米尔·普京作为“我的朋友”的照片，这“很奇怪”。
“当然这取决于美国总统，但是……这很奇怪，”泽连斯基用英语说道。
“他是一个侵略者，一个杀手......他不可能成为朋友。就是不可能，”他说，并补充说这就像说你在第二次世界大战期间与阿道夫·希特勒是朋友一样。
自2025年在椭圆形办公室与特朗普发生不愉快的遭遇以来，泽连斯基一直谨慎处理与美国的关系。
特朗普的两名特使一直试图在俄罗斯和乌克兰之间谈判达成一项和平协议，以结束巨大的生命损失。但他们往往看起来更符合莫斯科的立场，而不是基辅的立场。
本月早些时候在阿布扎比调解的最新一轮和平谈判没有取得明显进展：“我们知道的越多，问题就越多”，泽连斯基如此形容。
他表示，预计谈判将于 12 月恢复。
周四，唐纳德·特朗普在他的“真相社交”平台上发帖称，上周在中国与普京举行的峰会上，他敦促俄罗斯“撤回对整个欧洲领土的所有军事侵略”，并表示他相信与乌克兰达成和平协议“很有可能”。
但从其公开声明来看，俄罗斯似乎在所有事情上都回到了最初的强硬谈判立场。
泽伦斯基透露，目前尚不清楚欧洲谈判代表是否会像美国特使所宣布的那样参加谈判。
领导人称欧洲已准备好与俄罗斯就结束乌克兰战争进行谈判
特朗普称俄罗斯领导人为朋友后，泽连斯基称普京是“杀手”
乌克兰迫切需要谈判取得进展，结束俄罗斯长达五年的全面入侵。
俄罗斯在全国各地的袭击越来越频繁，伤亡也越来越大：被杀的平民人数创历史新高。
因此，泽伦斯基呼吁“真正有帮助的盟友，能够推动俄罗斯”取得成果，并敦促美国不辜负其作为“实力和尊重”强国的声誉。
“当你试图对侵略者保持中立时......这意味着你支持受害者，也支持侵略者。这是不对的，”他说。
美国声称自己是中立的：在复杂的过程中寻求双方之间能够维持的和平协议。

title_en: Can Rassvet, 'Russia's Starlink' change the course of the war in Ukraine?
title_zh: “俄罗斯星链”拉斯维特能否改变乌克兰战争的进程？
summary: SpaceX's US Starlink satellite system has played a key role in countering the Russian military in Ukraine, but now a Russian counterpart is under development. What could this mean for Ukraine?
summary_zh: SpaceX的美国星链卫星系统在对抗乌克兰境内的俄罗斯军队方面发挥了关键作用，但现在俄罗斯的对应系统正在开发中
body_en: Both Russian and international media refer to the satellite communications network Rassvet (Dawn) as the "Russian Starlink," a satellite internet service operated by the US company SpaceX.
Rassvet, which was developed by the Russian aerospace company Bureau 1440, operates in low Earth orbit.

Interest in the system surged after the Russian military lost access to Starlink terminals, which until then had ensured communications and internet access in the battle zone in Ukraine. On the front, for example, Starlink helps drone pilots and commanders receive images from drones equipped with cameras. Military personnel also communicate together thanks to Starlink.

Though Russia does not fall within Starlink's area of coverage, the Russian military managed to acquire "illegal" terminals through third countries and was thus using the same system as the Ukrainian army.

In early 2026, SpaceX, in coordination with the Ukrainian Defense Ministry, introduced a "whitelist," which registered all devices on Ukrainian territory authorized to operate on the Starlink network. Any terminals being used by Russian forces were subsequently deactivated, and reports of serious communication problems on the front then began to appear in Russian social media channels.

In May, the US news channel Bloomberg reported that the Ukrainian army had recaptured about 400 square kilometers (ca. 155 square miles) of Ukrainian territory since Russian forces lost access to Starlink.

Two first launches of serial Rassvet satellites took place in March and July 2026.

According to information from Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR) published by the Reuters news agency in early November, Russia has started using Rassvet for military communications over Ukraine and to carry out attacks.
The system is reportedly being used to improve strike accuracy, expand capabilities of reconnaissance drones and to strengthen resilience against electronic warfare.
HUR spokesperson Andriy Yusov also told Reuters that "the constellation is currently insufficient to provide uninterrupted coverage of Ukrainian territory."

Georgiy Trishkin, a rocket analyst and operator of Telegram channel Tekhassky Vestnik (The Texas Herald), told DW that Russia aims to have a functioning "sovereign" alternative to Starlink — consisting of 292 satellites in orbit — running by the end of 2027.

According to Serhii Beskrestnov, aka Flash, an advisor to the Ukrainian president , the main danger posed by the Rassvet system is that it could allow the Russian army to control drones over Ukrainian territory.
He also pointed out on the platform Facebook that the Ukrainian military cannot use Starlink to control drones over Russian territory, since the US service does not work there.
SpaceX remains far superior to Rassvet in tech terms

Inspired by the Starlink model, the Russian military also wants to be able to equip drones with terminals, which will enable connectivity in more remote parts of Ukrainian territory. Bureau 1440 unveiled some initial models last month, but according to Trishkin, the similarities between Rassvet and Starlink stop at the "basic features and concept."

"When it comes to details, these are completely different projects. No one can currently match SpaceX's technological edge — and especially its lead in production technology," he said, pointing out that while the Starlink constellation comprised over 10,000 satellites, Rassvet would not have more than 300 in its first phase.

He added that Bureau 1440 would struggle to make enough of the kits used on the ground. While SpaceX can manufacture about 15,000 per day, this would be a "remarkable achievement even over the course of a year" for the Russian company.
He also said that the terminals produced by Bureau 1440 were much more expensive than those by Starlink as they relied "on foreign components."
body_zh: 俄罗斯和国际媒体将卫星通信网络 Rassvet (Dawn) 称为“俄罗斯星链”，这是由美国 SpaceX 公司运营的卫星互联网服务。
Rassvet由俄罗斯航天公司Bureau 1440开发，在近地轨道运行。
在俄罗斯军方失去星链终端的访问权后，对该系统的兴趣激增，此前该终端一直确保乌克兰战区的通信和互联网接入。例如，在前端，星链可以帮助无人机飞行员和指挥官从配备摄像头的无人机接收图像。借助星链，军事人员也可以进行交流。
尽管俄罗斯不在星链覆盖范围内，但俄罗斯军方设法通过第三国获取“非法”终端，因此使用与乌克兰军队相同的系统。
2026 年初，SpaceX 与乌克兰国防部协调推出了一份“白名单”，登记了乌克兰境内所有有权在星链网络上运行的设备。俄罗斯军队使用的所有终端随后都被停用，俄罗斯社交媒体渠道上开始出现有关前线严重通信问题的报道。
5月，美国新闻频道彭博社报道称，自俄罗斯军队失去星链连接以来，乌克兰军队已夺回约400平方公里（约155平方英里）的乌克兰领土。
星链中断暴露了乌克兰对卫星的依赖

Rassvet 系列卫星的首次发射分别于 2026 年 3 月和 7 月进行了两次。
据路透社11月初公布的乌克兰军事情报局（HUR）信息，俄罗斯已开始利用Rassvet在乌克兰上空进行军事通信并实施攻击。
据报道，该系统被用来提高打击精度、扩大侦察无人机的能力并增强针对电子战的抵御能力。
HUR发言人安德烈·尤索夫也对路透社表示，“该星座目前不足以对乌克兰领土提供不间断的覆盖。”
火箭分析师兼 Telegram 频道 Tekhassky Vestnik（《德克萨斯先驱报》）操作员乔治·特里什金 (Georgiy Trishkin) 告诉德国之声，俄罗斯的目标是在 2027 年底前拥有一个可运行的“主权”替代星链——由 292 颗在轨卫星组成。
乌克兰总统顾问谢尔希·别斯克列斯特诺夫（Serhii Beskrestnov）（又名“Flash”）表示，“拉斯韦特”系统带来的主要危险在于，它可能会让俄罗斯军队控制乌克兰领土上空的无人机。
他还在脸书平台上指出，乌克兰军方无法使用星链控制俄罗斯领土上空的无人机，因为美国的服务在那里无法使用。
SpaceX 在技术方面仍然远远优于 Rassvet
受星链模式的启发，俄罗斯军方还希望能够为无人机配备终端，这将使乌克兰领土上更偏远的地区实现连接。 Bureau 1440 上个月公布了一些初始模型，但根据 Trishkin 的说法，Rassvet 和 Starlink 之间的相似之处仅限于“基本功能和概念”。
“说到细节，这是完全不同的项目。目前没有人能够与 SpaceX 的技术优势相媲美，尤其是其在生产技术方面的领先地位，”他说。他指出，虽然 Starlink 星座由 10,000 多颗卫星组成，但 Rassvet 第一阶段的卫星数量不会超过 300 颗。
他补充说，1440 局将很难生产足够的地面使用的套件。虽然 SpaceX 每天可以生产约 15,000 个，但这对于这家俄罗斯公司来说“即使在一年内也将是一个了不起的成就”。
他还表示，Bureau 1440 生产的终端比 Starlink 生产的终端贵得多，因为它们依赖“外国部件”。

title_en: Albania's youth are protesting in Flamingo Revolution, not leaving the country anymore
title_zh: 阿尔巴尼亚年轻人抗议火烈鸟革命，不再离开这个国家
summary: Youth protests against a rigid political system and corruption have shaken the government of Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama. They also show that fewer young people are willing to emigrate in search of a better future.
summary_zh: 青年人对僵化政治制度和腐败的抗议动摇了阿尔巴尼亚总理埃迪·拉马的政府。他们还表明，很少
body_en: In mid-October, students in the Albanian capital Tirana set a suitcase on fire and threw it into the courtyard of the Education Ministry. Everyone in the country understood the symbolism: According to the 2023 census, the population of this Western Balkan country shrunk by about 420,000 between 2011 and 2023 — by nearly 15% — primarily because of emigration.
For a generation of young Albanians, this was the response to a system that gave them little voice. But now young people want to stay, and the protesters are saying that the system has to change.

Known as the "Flamingo Revolution," the social movement began in May with demonstrations against a luxury resort in a coastal reserve that US President Donald Trump's daughter Ivanka Trump and her husband Jared Kushner were involved in.
It quickly evolved into broader criticism against corruption, Prime Minister Edi Rama's government and his ruling Socialist Party and the country's entire political class.

Thousands marched almost every evening for four months in protests that were largely peaceful. But on October 13, a student protest escalated and there were clashes with police. Since then, the unrest has continued, with police using tear gas, water cannons and rubber bullets against demonstrators. There have been hundreds of arrests and many injuries, amid damage to public and private property.

The protesters have called for Rama's resignation, a transitional government, electoral reform and fresh elections. The movement, which has no leader, has support from people across the political spectrum. And while the prime minister has blamed "foreign hands" for the movement, there seems to be little evidence that external actors are orchestrating the protests, though they may have attempted to exploit the unrest online.

The protesters, who do not feel represented by Albania's democracy, are driven by domestic issues: corruption, the high cost of living and low wages. This is nothing new, but many factors have converged recently: a series of high-level corruption charges, including against ministers and two of Rama's former deputies, rising prices and the fact that Albania is being measured against EU standards by a new generation.

In certain areas, Rama has transformed Albania since taking office in 2013: the economy has grown significantly, as the government likes to point out, and tourism is booming. But the prosperity remains unevenly distributed. Critics accuse the government of channeling too much taxpayer money into a small number of well-connected companies through prestigious projects and public-private partnerships, and in some cases through corrupt business deals, at the expense of healthcare, education and better economic prospects for the wider population.
Rama has rejected the calls for his resignation and has invited protesters to engage in dialogue, which they have so far refused.
Alternating between Socialist and Democratic Party

In 2008, Rama and Sali Berisha, the long-time chairman of the opposition Democratic Party, worked on a reform to Albania's constitution and electoral law, which was approved by parliament. Since then, it is party leaders who have determined who enters Parliament, which weakens ties between lawmakers and their constituents.

In addition, it has become significantly more difficult for new parties to win seats. In 2025, a new party received about 64,000 votes, but only one seat. The Socialists, by contrast, won about one seat for every 10,000 votes.

Rama has been the leader of the Socialists since 2005, while Berisha first became the chairman of the Democratic Party in 1991. For 21 years, Albania's prime minister has either been Rama or Berisha. Freedom House, a US nongovernmental organization that promotes democracy worldwide, classifies Albania as "partly free" and describes the country's political parties as being "often organized around leading personalities."
Protesters on the streets have said that they want both men to be jailed. Rama has argued that governments should be replaced at the ballot box, not on the streets.

Though the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) acknowledged that parliamentary elections in 2025 were "competitive and professionally managed" it said that they had taken place "in a highly polarized environment and contestants did not enjoy a level playing field."
It added that there were "reports of intimidation, misuse of public resources and pressure on public employees, which undermined equal opportunities."
The Democratic Party also spoke of election fraud and intimidation. Turnout was below 45%.
Protesters call out corruption, face high cost of living

Many protesters also allege that when it comes to business, what matters is the proximity to people in power. They criticize the public procurement, public auctions and concessions system, which has led to state-owned land, including coastal and protected areas, being sold to private investors.

Ordinary Albanians are feeling the financial brunt. According to the Albanian Institute of Statistics (INSTAT), half of all employees earn less than 60,000 lek (roughly €620 or $680) per month after taxes. But according to Eurostat, food prices are slightly above the EU average and real estate prices in Tirana have nearly doubled since 2018, with rents rising just as quickly.
body_zh: 10月中旬，阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那的学生点燃了一个手提箱，并将其扔进了教育部的庭院。这个国家的每个人都明白其中的象征意义：根据 2023 年人口普查，这个西巴尔干国家的人口在 2011 年至 2023 年间减少了约 42 万，即近 15%，主要是因为移民。
对于一代年轻的阿尔巴尼亚人来说，这是对他们几乎没有发言权的制度的反应。但现在年轻人想留下来，抗议者说这个制度必须改变。
这场被称为“火烈鸟革命”的社会运动始于五月，抗议美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的女儿伊万卡·特朗普和她的丈夫贾里德·库什纳参与的沿海保护区豪华度假村的示威活动。
它很快演变成对腐败、总理埃迪·拉玛政府及其执政的社会党以及该国整个政治阶层的更广泛的批评。
在四个月的时间里，数千人几乎每天晚上都举行游行，抗议活动基本上是和平的。但10月13日，学生抗议升级，并与警方发生冲突。此后，骚乱仍在继续，警方对示威者使用催泪瓦斯、高压水枪和橡皮子弹。公共和私人财产遭到破坏，数百人被捕，多人受伤。
抗议者呼吁拉玛辞职、组建过渡政府、进行选举改革和重新举行选举。该运动没有领导人，但得到了各个政治派别人士的支持。尽管总理将这场运动归咎于“外国人”，但似乎没有证据表明外部行为者正在策划抗议活动，尽管他们可能试图利用网上的骚乱。
抗议者感觉自己没有代表阿尔巴尼亚的民主，他们受到国内问题的驱使：腐败、高生活成本和低工资。这并不是什么新鲜事，但最近许多因素都集中在一起：一系列高层腐败指控，包括针对部长和拉马的两名前副手的指控、物价上涨以及阿尔巴尼亚新一代人正在根据欧盟标准来衡量这一事实。
自2013年上任以来，拉马在某些领域改变了阿尔巴尼亚：正如政府喜欢指出的那样，经济显着增长，旅游业蓬勃发展。但繁荣的分布仍然不均匀。批评者指责政府通过著名的项目和公私合作伙伴关系，在某些情况下通过腐败的商业交易，将过多的纳税人资金投入到少数人脉广泛的公司中，而牺牲了医疗保健、教育和更广泛人口的更好的经济前景。
拉玛拒绝了辞职的呼吁，并邀请抗议者进行对话，但他们迄今拒绝了。
社会党和民主党之间交替
2008年，拉马和长期担任反对党民主党主席的萨利·贝里沙致力于对阿尔巴尼亚宪法和选举法进行改革，并获得议会批准。从那时起，由政党领导人决定谁进入议会，这削弱了立法者与其选民之间的联系。
此外，新政党赢得席位变得更加困难。 2025年，一个新政党获得约64,000张选票，但只有一个席位。相比之下，社会党每 10,000 票就赢得大约一个席位。
拉马自2005年起一直担任社会党领袖，贝里沙则于1991年首次担任民主党主席。21年来，阿尔巴尼亚总理要么是拉马，要么是贝里沙。自由之家是一个在全球范围内促进民主的美国非政府组织，将阿尔巴尼亚归类为“部分自由”，并将该国的政党描述为“通常围绕领导人人物组织起来”。
街头抗议者表示，他们希望这两个人都被监禁。拉玛认为，政府应该在投票箱中更换，而不是在街头。
尽管欧洲安全与合作组织 (OSCE) 承认 2025 年议会选举是“竞争性的、专业管理的”，但表示选举是在“高度两极分化的环境中进行的，参赛者没有享受公平的竞争环境”。
它补充说，有“关于恐吓、滥用公共资源和对公职人员施加压力的报告，这破坏了平等机会。”
民主党还谈到了选举舞弊和恐吓。投票率低于 45%。
抗议者呼吁腐败，面临高昂的生活成本
许多抗议者还声称，在商业方面，重要的是与当权者的接近。他们批评公共采购、公开拍卖和特许制度，该制度导致包括沿海和保护区在内的国有土地被出售给私人投资者。
普通阿尔巴尼亚人正感受到经济上的冲击。根据阿尔巴尼亚统计研究所 (INSTAT) 的数据，一半员工的税后月收入低于 60,000 列克（约合 620 欧元或 680 美元）。但根据欧盟统计局的数据，食品价格略高于欧盟平均水平，地拉那的房地产价格自 2018 年以来几乎翻了一番，租金上涨同样迅速。

title_en: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
title_zh: 观看：恶劣天气袭击美国，屋顶被掀翻，街道被水淹没
summary: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.
summary_zh: 随着感恩节假期周末开始，该国数十万人受到风暴影响。
body_en: Powerful storms are battering both US coasts as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend gets under way.
Hundreds of flights have been cancelled and hundreds of thousands are without power, in states including Virginia, North Carolina and New Jersey.
Strong winds have blown roofs off houses and floodwater has submerged streets.
body_zh: 随着感恩节假期周末的到来，强大的风暴正在袭击美国两个海岸。
在弗吉尼亚州、北卡罗来纳州和新泽西州等州，数百架航班被取消，数十万人断电。
强风吹走了房屋的屋顶，洪水淹没了街道。

title_en: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
title_zh: 至少13名尼日尔士兵在萨纳姆武装袭击中丧生
summary: It remains unclear who carried out the attack on Niger's National Guard in Tillaberi, near the Mali border.
summary_zh: 目前尚不清楚是谁在马里边境附近的蒂拉贝里袭击了尼日尔国民警卫队。
body_en: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack | Boko Haram News | Al Jazeera
Share At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack on social media
At least 13 members of Niger’s National Guard have been killed and 20 wounded in an attack on their compound in Sanam, in the west of the country, the Defence Ministry has said.
In a statement read on state television, the ministry said the attack on Thursday was carried out by “numerous heavily armed assailants”, referring to the incident as a “terrorist attack”.

United States President Donald Trump has claimed Iran possesses missiles capable of reaching Europe and downplayed Russia and China’s support for Tehran while speaking to US military personnel by phone for the Thanksgiving holiday.

Taking questions from reporters at his Mar-a-Lago residence in Florida on Thursday, Trump said without “peace in the Middle East”, Iran could launch nuclear attacks against Israel and other countries in the region.

“We don’t need Middle East oil. But what we do need is we need peace in the Middle East,” Trump said, as OPEC ministers are scheduled to meet on Sunday to weigh 2027 oil production targets.

The US president and First Lady Melania Trump called US service members deployed across the region to praise their role in the war on Iran, including personnel at the al-Dhafra airbase in the United Arab Emirates and the Prince Sultan airbase in Saudi Arabia.
“Each of you is playing an essential role to protect not only our country today but future generations of Americans by ensuring that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon,” he said.

When asked if the US would renew strikes on Iran, the president said: “If we do something, we will definitely hit Pickaxe Mountain.” Trump also told reporters he spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in recent days.

The US is still offering Iran an opening to negotiate, according to Trump, who said: “We’re trying to be nice. We’re giving them every chance to make a deal and save a lot of lives, but I’m not sure if they are gonna take advantage of that.”
He downplayed the importance of intelligence-sharing by Russia and China with Iran, amid reports that the two countries helped Tehran target US bases.

“My meeting with President Xi was an incredible meeting. I think that they’re very little involved with Iran. They could get involved, but involvement to me would mean shooting, not giving them little information,” Trump said during the short news conference.
“We do the same thing, by the way. And you know, when they say that they may be spying on us, well, we spy on them too,” he added.

Trump’s statements come as Iran steps up attacks on US military targets across the region. On Saturday, Bahrain reported an Iranian attack on a civilian industrial facility while Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claimed it targeted US air defence radars in the country.
Kuwait said on Thursday that an Iranian drone attack on a “vital site” killed two Italian workers and injured four others. Tehran has denied involvement in the attack.
Trump told deployed service members, “You’re going to continue that deployment, and we have victory at hand,” referring to the war on Iran.
“It’s [victory] going to be whenever I want it to be, to be honest,” he added.

title_en: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
title_zh: 新西兰执政联盟仅落后议会多数席位一个席位
summary: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.
summary_zh: 国家党领导的右倾执政集团未能获得执政所需的多数席位。
body_en: New Zealand's ruling coalition has fallen short of a parliamentary majority by one seat, following a campaign shaped by a sluggish economy and disillusioned voters.
It now needs the support of the centrist Opportunity Party to remain in power. If they cannot reach a deal, the country may have to go back to the polls.
The incumbent National Party led by Prime Minister Christopher Luxon secured 40 out of 130 seats, while its coalition partners ACT and New Zealand First took 13 and 12 respectively.
A government led by the centre-left Labour Party is not possible, official results on Friday show, as the bloc would not have enough seats even if Opportunity threw its weight behind it.
Luxon on Friday acknowledged that negotiations "may be challenging" and will take some time.
"Kiwis won't thank us for rushing to an agreement that falls apart or for sending them back to the polls," he told reporters.

Labour leader Chris Hipkins said his party "ran an incredible campaign" but acknowledged that it doesn't have negotiating power despite winning the popular vote. "More New Zealanders voted for change at this election than for the status quo," he said.

New Zealand's mixed-member proportional voting system means most governments are coalitions. Each person casts two votes – one for their preferred political party and another for their choice of local representative.
Labour secured 36 seats, The Greens took 17, while Te Pāti Māori, which represents Māori interests, picked up five.

Opportunity, which has been described as this election's kingmaker, secured seven seats. Opportunity's leader Qiulae Wong told reporters her party will negotiate with National, but that all options remain on the table.
"There are seven parties in parliment and everyone is responsible for making sure we do everything we can to deliver a stable government for New Zealand. It's not just up to us," she said on Friday.
Preliminary results on 7 November, election day, had projected that National combined with its coalition partners would have a slim lead over the left-leaning bloc.
But today's official tally shows it had lost two seats on special votes - cast by citizens who were overseas or outside of their registered electorate on election day - which typically skew left.
Some of National's key election pledges include lower taxes, cheaper energy, more renewable generation, and a greater focus on defence.
Labour, meanwhile, had campaigned to cut healthcare, public transport and fuel costs, more government support for social housing, among other things.
In earlier interviews with the BBC, many voters had expressed frustration over spiralling costs of living and high unemployment across the country, with declining faith in their political leadership.
"There's this kind of apathy and a bit of dread," said 21-year-old Imogen Vlutger.
A 40-year-old man said he didn't vote as he could not bring himself to tick any of the boxes on the ballot paper.
More than half of the country no longer see New Zealand as a land of opportunity, according to a survey by the Helen Clark Foundation, a public policy think tank.
Kiwis have been leaving the country in record numbers, with many of them, including former prime minister Jacinda Arden , moving to Australia.
body_zh: 由于经济低迷和选民幻灭，新西兰执政联盟以一个席位未能获得议会多数席位。
它现在需要中间派机会党的支持才能继续执政。如果他们无法达成协议，该国可能不得不重新投票。
由总理克里斯托弗·卢克森 (Christopher Luxon) 领导的现任国家党获得了 130 个席位中的 40 个，而其联盟伙伴行动党和新西兰优先党分别获得了 13 个和 12 个席位。
周五的官方结果显示，由中左翼工党领导的政府是不可能的，因为即使机遇号大力支持，该集团也不会获得足够的席位。
Luxon 周五承认，谈判“可能具有挑战性”，并且需要一些时间。
他对记者说：“新西兰人不会感谢我们仓促达成一项最终破裂的协议，也不会感谢我们让他们重新投票。”
工党领袖克里斯·希普金斯表示，他的政党“进行了一场令人难以置信的竞选活动”，但承认尽管赢得了普选，但它没有谈判能力。他说：“更多的新西兰人在这次选举中投票支持变革，而不是维持现状。”
新西兰的混合成员比例投票制度意味着大多数政府都是联合政府。每个人投两票——一票投给他们喜欢的政党，另一票投给他们选择的当地代表。
工党获得 36 个席位，绿党获得 17 个席位，而代表毛利利益的 Te Pāti Māori 则获得 5 个席位。
被称为本次选举的“造王者”的机会党获得了七个席位。机会党领袖 Qiulae Wong 告诉记者，她的政党将与国家党进行谈判，但所有选择仍然存在。
“议会中有七个政党，每个人都有责任确保我们尽一切努力为新西兰建立一个稳定的政府。这不仅仅取决于我们，”她周五表示。
11 月 7 日选举日的初步结果预计，国家党及其联盟伙伴将以微弱优势领先左倾集团。
但今天的官方统计显示，该党在特别投票中失去了两个席位，这些特别投票是由海外或在选举日登记选民之外的公民投票的，这些投票通常偏向左翼。
国家党的一些关键选举承诺包括降低税收、降低能源价格、增加可再生能源发电以及更加注重国防。
与此同时，工党发起了削减医疗保健、公共交通和燃料成本、政府对社会住房的更多支持等活动。
在早些时候接受英国广播公司采访时，许多选民对全国各地不断上升的生活成本和高失业率表示沮丧，对他们的政治领导力信心下降。
“有一种冷漠和一点恐惧，”21 岁的伊莫金·弗鲁特格 (Imogen Vlutger) 说。
一名 40 岁的男子表示，他没有投票，因为他无法在选票上勾选任何选项。
公共政策智库海伦克拉克基金会的一项调查显示，超过一半的国家不再将新西兰视为充满机遇的土地。
新西兰人离开新西兰的人数创历史新高，其中许多人，包括前总理杰辛达·阿登，移居澳大利亚。

title_en: ‘I’m no longer a UAE official’: UN hopeful Lana Nusseibeh tries to shake off Sudan record
title_zh: “我不再是阿联酋官员”：联合国候选人拉娜·努赛贝试图摆脱苏丹记录
summary: The US and Russia’s candidate for secretary general is on a charm offensive. Can she overcome London’s resistance to her bid? Lana Nusseibeh is in Britain this week, attempting to present herself as a potential future UN secretary general, and shift the focus
summary_zh: 美国和俄罗斯的秘书长候选人正在进行魅力攻势。她能克服伦敦对她申办的阻力吗？拉娜·努赛贝 (Lana Nusseibeh) 在 Bri
body_en: The US and Russia’s candidate for secretary general is on a charm offensive. Can she overcome London’s resistance to her bid?

L ana Nusseibeh is in Britain this week, attempting to present herself as a potential future UN secretary general, and shift the focus from her past as a United Arab Emirates diplomat who denied the country’s role in arming a militia accused of war crimes and genocide in Sudan’s four-year civil war.
It is a high-risk strategy that involves meeting ministers, MPs, academics and holding a public event with the UN Association.

Labelled by many British NGOs and others as an apologist for war crimes, Nusseibeh is presenting herself as a skilled diplomat with the network to put the UN back at the centre of mediation, development and human rights.

“These are very geopolitical times,” she said in an interview. “You need a geopolitical secretary general, because the fact is these geopolitical ruptures are not going away. These fissures in the international system are not going to dissolve any time soon.”

Nusseibeh had a setback last Friday, when three permanent members of the UN security council, China, France and the UK , all voted to “discourage” her candidature. The UN’s electoral system requires that she secure nine positive votes from the 15-strong security council, and no discouragement from the permanent five (P5) before being recommended to the UN general assembly.

She has the backing of the US and Russia, and thinks her cause is not lost. “Sometimes, the use of the veto is tactical. Sometimes, it’s a holding position, sometimes it’s a leveraging position. There are a number of different theories”.
The centre of the resistance to Nusseibeh’s candidacy is probably London, and specifically the Foreign Office, the penholder on Sudan at the UN, and this may explain the UK political blitz.

When questioned about her role in Sudan, she asked that her candidacy be seen in the round, highlighting her role in forcing humanitarian aid into Gaza, her support for Afghan women and promoting interfaith tolerance.
Sudanese diaspora and human rights groups denounce UAE nominee for UN top job
“Like every candidate, I come from somewhere, but the independence of the incoming secretary general is the key to their credibility.

“I’ve taken a leave of absence from my role in [the] UAE government in order to independently campaign for this role. But I think that if I was secretary general, Sudan would be the litmus test of success for any incoming secretary because it’s such a horrific humanitarian crisis.”

The war in Sudan, which erupted in April 2023 after a power struggle between the ​military and the Rapid Support Forces, has displaced more than 14 million people and created one of the world’s worst humanitarian crises. Multiple regional powers, including the UAE , have backed different local proxies since the beginning of the conflict in an attempt to win influence and strategic resources.
The UAE has long been accused of supporting the RSF in Sudan, a charge repeatedly denied by Nusseibeh, who has publicly disputed the findings of UN investigators.
A UN panel of experts suggested last month that the UAE had supplied crucial support to the RSF.

Asked if she regretted dissembling during her time as a diplomat, by denying the UAE had armed the RSF, or her personal role in challenging the UN reports critical of the UAE, Nusseibeh said she regretted that “the Sudanese civil war had continued for so long”.

Nusseibeh added: “But I don’t think saying that is enough for the Sudanese people and the people in the surrounding countries where they’ve also felt the impact of this war, or for the victims of sexual violence and in this conflict, the atrocities committed in El Fasher without accountability, and the use of chemical weapons against the civilian population; all of these are a litany of suffering that has been inflicted on the Sudanese people.”

Asked if the UAE had been supplying weapons to the RSF in a breach of a UN embargo, she replied: “I’m aware of the allegations. I haven’t read the last UN panel of experts report, but I’m not going to comment as I’m no longer a UAE official. In this campaign, I am a secretary general candidate.

“As secretary general, I would fully back the findings of all UN panel of experts reports and I’m aware that I think several countries have been mentioned in various reports.”She later added: “I would call out countries that are supplying arms to any of the parties, including those in the RSF … this needs a process that requires accountability for atrocities that have been committed. That it needs to be a process primarily led by the Sudanese people.”
body_zh: 美国和俄罗斯的秘书长候选人正在进行魅力攻势。她能克服伦敦对她申办的阻力吗？
拉娜·努塞贝本周在英国，试图以未来潜在的联合国秘书长的身份展现自己，并将焦点从她作为阿拉伯联合酋长国外交官的过去转移，她否认该国在武装被指控在苏丹四年内战中犯有战争罪和种族灭绝罪的民兵中所扮演的角色。
这是一项高风险策略，涉及与部长、议员、学者会面以及与联合国协会举行公共活动。
努塞贝被许多英国非政府组织和其他组织称为战争罪行的辩护者，她将自己描绘成一名熟练的外交官，通过网络让联合国重新回到调解、发展和人权的中心。
“这是一个非常地缘政治的时代，”她在接受采访时说。 “你需要一位地缘政治秘书长，因为事实是这些地缘政治破裂不会消失。国际体系中的这些裂痕不会很快消失。”
努塞贝上周五遭遇挫折，联合国安理会三个常任理事国中国、法国和英国都投票“阻止”她的候选资格。联合国的选举制度要求，在被推荐给联合国大会之前，她必须获得15个安理会成员中的9票赞成，并且不得受到五个常任理事国（P5）的反对。
她得到了美国和俄罗斯的支持，并认为她的事业没有失败。 “有时，否决权的使用是战术性的。有时，这是一种保留立场，有时是一种杠杆立场。有很多不同的理论”。
反对努塞贝候选资格的中心可能是伦敦，特别是联合国苏丹事务的起草人外交部，这或许可以解释英国的政治闪电战。
当被问及她在苏丹的角色时，她要求全面看待她的候选资格，强调她在迫使人道主义援助进入加沙、支持阿富汗妇女和促进宗教间宽容方面所发挥的作用。
苏丹侨民和人权组织谴责阿联酋联合国最高职位提名人
“像每一位候选人一样，我来自某个地方，但即将上任的秘书长的独立性是他们可信度的关键。
“我已经辞去了阿联酋政府的职务，以便独立竞选这一职位。但我认为，如果我担任秘书长，苏丹将成为任何即将上任的秘书长成功的试金石，因为这是一场如此可怕的人道主义危机。”
苏丹战争于 2023 年 4 月在军队和快速支援部队之间爆发权力斗争后爆发，已导致超过 1400 万人流离失所，并造成了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。自冲突爆发以来，包括阿联酋在内的多个地区大国一直支持不同的当地代理人，试图赢得影响力和战略资源。
阿联酋长期以来一直被指控支持苏丹的无国界记者组织，努塞贝一再否认这一指控，并公开质疑联合国调查人员的调查结果。
联合国专家小组上个月表示，阿联酋向无国界医生组织提供了重要支持。
当被问及她是否后悔在担任外交官期间否认阿联酋武装了无国界部队，或她个人在挑战联合国批评阿联酋的报告中所扮演的角色时，努塞贝表示，她对“苏丹内战持续了这么长时间”感到遗憾。
努塞贝补充道：“但我认为，对于苏丹人民和周边国家的人民来说，这些还不够，他们也感受到了这场战争的影响，或者对于性暴力和这场冲突的受害者来说，在法希尔没有追究责任的暴行以及对平民使用化学武器；所有这些都是苏丹人民遭受的一连串痛苦。”
当被问及阿联酋是否违反联合国禁运向无国界部队提供武器时，她回答说：“我知道这些指控。我还没有读过联合国专家小组的上一份报告，但我不会发表评论，因为我不再是阿联酋官员。在这次竞选中，我是秘书长候选人。
“作为秘书长，我完全支持所有联合国专家小组报告的调查结果，我知道我认为各种报告中都提到了几个国家。”她后来补充道：“我会呼吁向任何一方提供武器的国家，包括无国界部队的国家……这需要一个程序，要求对所犯下的暴行负责。这需要是一个主要由苏丹人民领导的程序。”

Agence France-Presse (AFP) has been hit by a cyberattack, requiring the AFP Forum content platform to be taken offline.
The France-based international news agency’s management said on Thursday that it is currently investigating the circumstances of the cyberattack, including who was behind it.

“AFP was hit by a cyber attack overnight, starting at 1:30 am (Paris time) [00:30 GMT]. The target was AFP Forum, one of the platforms our clients use to browse and download our content,” an internal email from AFP management said.

“As soon as the intrusion was detected, our teams moved immediately to contain the intrusion and took AFP Forum offline as a precautionary measure. AFP Forum remains unavailable until further notice.”

France’s cybersecurity chief, Vincent Strubel, warned on Thursday that the country faces an unprecedented level of cybersecurity threats and called for collective efforts to strengthen defences against attacks.
“We are facing a level of threat that is unprecedented, with an intensity we have never experienced before,” Strubel said in an interview with France Inter radio.

The incident is the latest in a slew of cybersecurity disruptions across European countries. FIFA, which is based in Zurich, Switzerland, confirmed to Al Jazeera on Thursday that it had been the victim of a cyberattack that gave unauthorised access to personal and business information.
In October, several French supermarkets were hit by an “unprecedented” cyberattack that raised the temperature of fridges and freezers to as high as 50 degrees Celsius (122F).
Temperature spikes were also recorded in stores in 10 other European countries in early November, including the United Kingdom, Germany, Belgium and Sweden.
France accused Tehran of being behind the October attack and summoned Iran’s ambassador to Paris to “lodge a very strong protest”.
Iran called Paris’s accusations “baseless” and condemned the “hackneyed policy of levelling accusations against the Islamic republic”.

法国网络安全负责人文森特·斯特鲁贝尔周四警告称，该国面临着前所未有的网络安全威胁，并呼吁集体努力加强对攻击的防御。

该事件是欧洲国家发生的一系列网络安全中断事件中的最新一起。总部位于瑞士苏黎世的国际足联周四向半岛电视台证实，它是一次网络攻击的受害者，该攻击导致未经授权的个人和商业信息被访问。
10 月，法国几家超市遭遇“前所未有”的网络攻击，冰箱和冰柜的温度高达 50 摄氏度（122 华氏度）。

法国指责德黑兰是十月袭击事件的幕后黑手，并召见伊朗驻巴黎大使“提出非常强烈的抗议”。

title_en: Argentina bars Central Bank from printing money to fund government spending
title_zh: 阿根廷禁止央行印钞为政府支出提供资金

body_en: Share Argentina bars Central Bank from printing money to fund government spending on social media

Argentina’s legislature has pushed forward a series of bills that would implement changes sought by President Javier Milei , including barring the Central Bank from printing extra money for government expenses.

On Thursday, the Argentinian Chamber of Deputies gave final approval to a bill imposing restrictions on the Central Bank, defining its “primary and fundamental mission” as maintaining the value of the country’s currency.

Under past administrations, the Central Bank has printed additional funds to help cover government expenses, contributing to the country’s once sky-high inflation, which reached more than 200 percent in 2023.
Milei, a libertarian economist, swept into office that year on a promise to tame runaway inflation and slash government spending.
Under his leadership, inflation has declined, though poverty has surged. Economists also believe Argentina may be drifting into a recession, with economic activity diminished in recent months.
Still, Milei’s office celebrated the Senate’s passage of the Central Bank bill with a presidential statement.
“This marks the end of nearly two decades of political manipulation at the Central Bank,” the statement said.
The bank, founded in 1935, had experienced “91 years of plunder, expropriation, impunity, and institutional decay” up to this point, it added.
The vote in the Chamber of Deputies was 141 to zero, with 99 abstentions.
The Senate previously passed the bill, though it removed language Milei had pressed for, which would have required a two-thirds vote in both chambers of Congress to remove Central Bank governors.
Also on Thursday, Argentina’s Senate advanced a bill to reform the country’s elections by suspending its primaries.
Unlike the Central Bank reform, that bill was not final. It still needs to pass the Chamber of Deputies.
The bill, however, comes less than a year before Argentina is slated to hold its next presidential election. Milei is expected to seek re-election in the October 24 vote.
Critics see the suspension of primaries as a means for Milei to avoid early pushback in his campaign.

A dismal primary result, they say, could weaken his momentum ahead of the general election and cause unfavourable economic fluctuations. Milei has long faced public discontent over his programme of economic austerity .
Thursday’s bill would also reduce public financing for political parties and eliminate a mandatory presidential debate ahead of general elections.

在过去的政府领导下，央行印制了额外的资金来帮助支付政府开支，导致该国一度飙升的通货膨胀率，在 2023 年达到了 200% 以上。
自由主义经济学家米雷当年就任总统，承诺抑制失控的通货膨胀并削减政府支出。
在他的领导下，尽管贫困人口激增，但通货膨胀率有所下降。经济学家还认为，随着近几个月经济活动的减少，阿根廷可能正陷入衰退。
尽管如此，米莱的办公室还是发表了一份总统声明，庆祝参议院通过央行法案。
声明称：“这标志着央行近二十年政治操纵的结束。”
它补充说，该银行成立于 1935 年，迄今为止已经经历了“91 年的掠夺、征用、有罪不罚和制度衰败”。
众议院投票结果为 141 票对 0 票，99 票弃权。
参议院此前通过了该法案，但删除了米莱所要求的措辞，因为这需要国会两院三分之二的票数才能罢免央行行长。
同样在周四，阿根廷参议院提出了一项法案，通过暂停初选来改革该国的选举。
与央行改革不同的是，该法案并不是最终版本。它还需要在众议院获得通过。
然而，该法案是在阿根廷预定举行下一届总统选举前不到一年提出的。米莱预计将在10月24日的投票中寻求连任。
批评人士认为，暂停初选是米雷避免竞选活动早期遭遇阻力的一种手段。
他们表示，惨淡的初选结果可能会削弱他在大选前的势头，并导致不利的经济波动。米莱长期以来一直面临公众对其经济紧缩计划的不满。
周四的法案还将减少对政党的公共资助，并取消大选前的强制性总统辩论。

From claims that undocumented migrants are being illegally registered to vote, to allegations that postal ballots and vote counts could be manipulated, internet users are accusing Pedro Sánchez's government of attempting to rig the election. title_en: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
title_zh: 载重 7,000 吨的柴油油轮在伊维萨岛附近沉没，造成一人死亡
summary: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.
summary_zh: 西班牙海上救援部门仍在评估可能造成的环境损害。
body_en: Med Emre: Diesel tanker carrying tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one - BBC News
An oil tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel has capsized off the coast of Ibiza, leaving one crew member dead, authorities have said.

The Med Emre, a Malta-flagged vessel, was carrying 17 crew members who were all rescued. However seven were taken to hospital and one was later pronounced dead, Balearic Islands emergency services confirmed.
The six crew receiving treatment reportedly suffered minor injuries, such as hypothermia, Spanish media reports.
The possible environmental damage is being assessed by a plane and Spain's pollution control vessel, Clara Campoamor, which is owned by the country's national maritime rescue service.
"There is still little information available about a possible fuel spill," Balearic Islands' President Marga Prohens wrote on X.
Elena Delgado, maritime captain of Valencia, told news agency AFP that a small slick that had formed around the boat had "disappeared".
"The situation is stabilised," she said, adding that further inspections would be carried out on Friday morning.
Earlier, regional emergencies director Pablo Gárriz said the tanker had not completely sunk, as had originally been reported. The vessel remains partially submerged.
The Med Emre capsized 25 nautical miles (46 km; 29 miles) from Ibiza's coastline and 57 nautical miles from Valencia. It is unclear what caused the sinking.
The chemical tanker was en route from Algeciras, in southern Spain, to Barcelona in the north-east.

Rescuers in Valencia received a distress call around 22:30 local time (21:30 GMT) on Wednesday, according to Spanish media. Minutes later, the vessel reported a leak and the crew said it was leaning at a 90-degree angle.
The injured crew members have been taken to hospitals in Valencia and Can Misses Hospital in Ibiza, President Prohens said.

Ibiza's marine environment was added to the Unesco World Heritage List in 1999. In particular, it is home to dense prairies of Posidonia oceanic seagrass, which is found only in the Mediterranean basin and plays a vital role in supporting local marine biodiversity.

In 2002, Spain experienced one of its worst environmental disasters when the Prestige oil tanker ran into trouble off Galicia's coastline . It spilled more than 60,000 tonnes of heavy fuel oil into the sea.
body_zh: Med Emre：载重吨柴油油轮在伊维萨岛附近倾覆，造成一人死亡 -_澳门赌博平台
当局表示，一艘载有多达 7,000 吨柴油的油轮在伊维萨岛海岸倾覆，造成一名船员死亡。
Med Emre 号是一艘悬挂马耳他国旗的船只，船上有 17 名船员，全部获救。然而，巴利阿里群岛紧急服务部门证实，七人被送往医院，其中一人后来被宣布死亡。
据西班牙媒体报道，接受治疗的六名船员据称受了轻伤，例如体温过低。
一架飞机和西班牙污染控制船 Clara Campoamor 正在评估可能造成的环境损害，该船隶属于该国国家海上救援机构。
巴利阿里群岛总统玛加·普罗恩斯 (Marga Prohens) 在 X 上写道：“有关可能发生的燃油泄漏的信息仍然很少。”
巴伦西亚船长埃琳娜·德尔加多（Elena Delgado）告诉法新社，船周围形成的一小块浮油已经“消失”。
“情况已经稳定，”她说，并补充说，周五早上将进行进一步检查。
早些时候，地区紧急情况主管巴勃罗·加里兹表示，油轮并未像最初报道的那样完全沉没。该船仍部分淹没。
Med Emre 号在距离伊维萨岛海岸线 25 海里（46 公里；29 英里）、距离巴伦西亚 57 海里处倾覆。目前尚不清楚沉没的原因。
这艘化学品船当时正从西班牙南部的阿尔赫西拉斯驶往东北部的巴塞罗那。
据西班牙媒体报道，巴伦西亚的救援人员于当地时间周三 22:30（格林尼治标准时间 21:30）左右接到求救信号。几分钟后，该船报告发生泄漏，船员称该船已倾斜 90 度角。
普罗恩斯总统说，受伤的船员已被送往巴伦西亚的医院和伊维萨岛的坎米西斯医院。
伊维萨岛的海洋环境于1999年被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录。特别是，这里有茂密的波西多尼亚海洋海草草原，这种海草仅见于地中海盆地，对支持当地海洋生物多样性发挥着至关重要的作用。
2002年，西班牙经历了最严重的环境灾难之一，当时“Prestige”号油轮在加利西亚海岸线遭遇麻烦。超过 60,000 吨重油泄漏入海。
